environment.cpuLimit: No hard CPU quota or affinity; 4 Tokio workers, 32 logical CPUs; no concurrent builds/tests during this native gate
environment.memoryLimit: No hard memory quota; private memory stop=4GiB, working set stop=8GiB, host free reserve=8GiB
environment.storage: Local Windows scratch File store; unthrottled disk; process IO includes file/device IO
environment.database: Dedicated fresh File backend; PostgreSQL not exercised
environment.network: Literal loopback; no external NIC throughput, PPS, retransmission or cloud bandwidth certificate
environment.tls: Plain WS/HTTP on loopback only; TLS not exercised
environment.failureDomain: One development host; no failover, N+1, power/disk failure scope
